description: Returns a list of track reviews with optional filtering, sorting and pagination. Includes new boolean field 'track_audiodownload_allowed' indicating if download is permitted, and note that 'track_audiodownload' will be empty when this flag is false.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wrap the JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with json format and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 10, max 200. Keyword 'all' still limited to 200 rows.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by field(s). Append _asc or _desc for direction; default is ascending.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, adds 'results_fullcount' header with total rows ignoring limit/offset. Use sparingly as it impacts performance.

parameters.name: datebetween
parameters.description: Closed interval filter for review dates formatted as "yyyy-mm-dd_yyyy-mm-dd".

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: One or more user IDs (no token required).

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: OAuth2 access token for the Jamendo user.

parameters.name: hasscore
parameters.description: Filter reviews that have (or do not have) a score.

parameters.name: album_id
parameters.description: An album ID to filter reviews.

parameters.name: artist_id
parameters.description: An artist ID to filter reviews.

parameters.name: audioformat
parameters.description: Audio format for the 'audio' field. Default mp31.

parameters.name: audiodlformat
parameters.description: Audio download format for the 'audiodownload' field. Defaults to audioformat, otherwise mp32.

responseFields.name: agreecnt
responseFields.description: Number of agreements on the review.

responseFields.name: track_audiodownload_allowed
responseFields.description: Indicates whether the track can be offered for download via the API.

notes: Since Feb 2021 the field 'track_audiodownload_allowed' is always returned.
From Apr 2022, if 'track_audiodownload_allowed' is false, the 'track_audiodownload' field will be an empty string.
Using 'fullcount=true' may impact performance and is not available on some heavy methods.
